set.body:
Outcome

Demonstrate that the predictive program uses the common measurement and result model.

Acceptance

- The same estimand runs over a region, searchlight frame, and identity/global measurement.
- One failed measurement does not erase successful outcomes.
- Result scattering consumes typed rendition metadata, not searchlight fields in generic support.
- Dense and operator-backed sources produce the same scientific values; any local densification is explicit.
set.title: P4A.6: execute predictive estimands across MeasurementFrame and render spatial results
